title: Cosmic zoo explanation for diverse craft

tellings.quote: Um the idea that we're living in a cosmic zoo.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange lights and craft, offers one idea for why so many different kinds of craft seem to show up: "the idea that we're living in a cosmic zoo." He puts it to Michels as a possibility based on what he says he has seen there. The idea is that if it were true, humans would be watched by many different visitors, like animals in a zoo.
